content:
alex: starting thread — sudden 5xx spike on hosted inference (apigw -> runtime). Customer-facing errors reported, support pinged.

emily: seeing a clear p95 increase and a 503 spike around 02:12 UTC. dashboards: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/hosted-inference/overview

sam: @oncall stepping in. I can repro small sample via curl — lots of 502/503 from gateway. Quick check: router logs show upstream connection resets.

raj: adding context from support: two customers reported timeouts and got 5xx when hitting /v1/chat/complete with stream=true. They included a request id.

li: pointing to recent routing change — we rolled out a fallback policy that re-routes to variant-b at 02:00 UTC for capacity smoothing. Rolling window looks correlated.

sam: can we confirm whether variant-b has the same chunked-streaming behavior? If not, that could explain connection issues.

emily: variant-b is quantized and uses a different sidecar. It doesn't support streaming fallback fully — we degrade to blocking mode. That mismatch could be 1) proxy keepalive mismatch 2) client expecting streaming but upstream returning chunked-block.

incident-bot: Created #warroom-1812349999 and notified oncall, eng-sre, runtime.

raj: mitigation idea — pin customer traffic to variant-a for the next 30m and pause the fallback policy. Also enable circuit breaker to route failing requests to 429 quickly.

sam: doing pin now. 
sam: command: 
```bash
# pin route to variant-a
redwood ctl route set --endpoint /v1/chat/complete --model variant-a --sticky 1800
```

sam: pinned. Observed a drop in 5xx after ~90s. p50 back to normal but p95 still elevated for some requests.

emily: confirming metrics — 5xx rate down from 4.2% to 0.6% in the last 3 minutes. Good. Need postmortem to understand fallback mismatch and streaming contract.

li: immediate root cause hypothesis: fallback routing sent streaming requests to a non-streaming runtime (variant-b) causing proxy to detect broken stream and abort with 502/503. Also missing header translation for connection: keep-alive -> close.

raj: customer impact: two paid customers saw ~3-5 min of errors, support issued temporary credits and comms.

sam: short-term actions completed: pinned route, disabled fallback policy, increased circuit-breaker sensitivity.

emily: medium-term fixes to own: 1) add an automated compatibility check when registering model variants (streaming support bit) 2) prevent fallback to incompatible variants 3) add specific alert for fallback->non-streaming mismatch.

li: technical notes to include in postmortem: headers we saw in gateway logs:
```
GET /v1/chat/complete HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Connection: keep-alive
Transfer-Encoding: chunked
X-Redwood-Model: variant-b
X-Request-ID: req_01F2Z9ABCD
```
Gateway then attempted keepalive reuse with variant-b sidecar which returned immediate EOF leading to upstream reset.
```
[2026-03-15T02:12:14Z] gateway ERROR upstream reset id=req_01F2Z9ABCD proto=chunked upstream=10.12.5.9:8080
[2026-03-15T02:12:14Z] gateway WARN retrying request id=req_01F2Z9ABCD attempts=1
[2026-03-15T02:12:15Z] gateway ERROR request failed id=req_01F2Z9ABCD code=502 reason="upstream reset"
```

raj: action items (assign):
- sam: add emergency switch to disable fallback policies by customer or endpoint (done in mitigation, add docs).
- emily: own postmortem writeup + timeline and customer comms (due EOD).
- li: implement variant capability flag and preflight check in model catalog (PR due in 5 business days).
- alex: update runbook with streaming compatibility checks and add unit tests for header translation (due in 3 days).

alex: confirmed. Also propose adding an alert for sudden mismatch between "requested streaming" vs "runtime supports streaming" metrics.

sam: small follow-up — we should backfill tests that simulate fallback to non-streaming runtimes to avoid regressions.

emily: customers notified and credits applied. support ticket IDs: SUP-9482, SUP-9483.

li: postmortem checklist entries: root cause, timeline, mitigation, long-term fix, owners, verification plan. I'll draft the PR for the model registry change and link.

sam: verification: after pinning we saw no errors for 25 minutes across affected endpoints. I'll keep watch for 2h.

emily: retro note: rollout of fallback policy lacked gating against runtime capability — need to add gating for critical endpoints (streaming endpoints are critical).

alex: any blockers for the fixes?

li: main blocker is small refactor in model registration UI + API, but that is scoped. No infra blockers.

raj: closing notes: assign this thread to emily for postmortem and to li for follow-up PRs. We'll schedule a 30-min retro tomorrow 15:00 UTC to walk timeline and confirm alerts.

emily: ack. I'll publish a short incident summary in #incidents and tag customers.

sam: leaving watch. ping me if anything spikes. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident 1812349999 marked resolved by sam. Postmortem pending.
